gloss: to cultivate; to foster; to nurture

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {培|つちか}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to cultivate; to foster; to nurture
definitions.explanation: to develop or nurture qualities, skills, or relationships over time

examples.japanese: ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{培|つちか}ってきた⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are skills cultivated over many years.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感性|かんせい}→感性：12628_kansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}うこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to nurture children's sensitivity.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally to heap soil around plant roots (the 培 of ⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧); now almost always figurative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う: to build up trust
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う: to develop skills
- ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う: to foster a friendship
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{培|つちか}ってきた～: ~ built up over many years

USAGE:
Somewhat formal, common in writing and speeches. It implies slow, patient development and is often used with ～てきた or as {培|つちか}われた～.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise, to grow (general; children, plants, people)
- ⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧: to nourish, to build up strength or a habit (⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧)
- ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish, to hone a skill already there
